test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A man drove from home to a town at the speed of 60 km/hr and on his return journey, he drove at the speed of 30 km/hr and also took an hour longer to reach home. What distance did he cover each way?
solution:
Let

Distance between home and town = d km.

Time to drove from home to town = T hr

∴ Time taken to drove back = (T + 1) hr

We know that,

Speed = Distance/Time

∵ Distance from home to town
